title: Choose Wakelatch's visual world
question: The roll assigned the station clock. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Station Clock
options.lineage: Swiss railway station clock (Mondaine/SBB, Hans Hilfiker 1944)
options.thesis: The railway clock whose red second hand stops at twelve and waits for the signal before the minute moves on. Wakelatch is that pause: the alarm holds until you give the signal. Refuses the category's sunrise gradients and neon-on-black.
options.viewport: Home: native nav, large title 'Tomorrow'. A full-width dial drawn as bar indices, with the Ideal-to-Deadline window as a thick white arc and each ring (nudges, main, guards, deadline) as a bar tick. Below it, a grouped native list: Ideal 6:40, Deadline 7:15, challenge per alarm. The red paddle disc sits on the dial only when a latch is armed. Morning: black screen, the dial alone, red paddle at twelve, 'Ring 3 of 10. Solve to stop.', then the challenge with a full-width answer field and system keypad.
options.risk: A clock dial on an alarm app can read as literal; it only works if the dial carries real schedule data and the red is reserved for the latch.

raised.raise: Every alarm stage (nudge, main, guard, deadline, awake check) is drawn at one fixed scale on one shared timeline, so mornings compare at a glance in the history view.
One form repeated at every size: the bar-index dial is the app icon, the Live Activity glyph, the timeline tick and the full morning dial.
Morning screens keep one element on a vast black field; nothing else is printed until the challenge appears.

options.label: Boarding Pass
options.thesis: Ideal is Boarding, Deadline is Gate closes. Tomorrow's alarms are a pass with a perforated stub you tear off by finishing the challenge.
options.viewport: Home: native nav, the pass as the lead block (BOARDS 6:40, GATE CLOSES 7:15, rings as seat-row codes), grouped list below. Morning: the stub, 'Gate closes in 18 min'.
options.risk: Familiar: travel metaphors are a common move for scheduling apps, and a pale card is wrong in a dark bedroom.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Each morning screen is one yellow band with the single next decision and a monumental number.
options.viewport: Morning: one yellow band, '3 of 10', the next ring time monumental; home is a chain of bands for tomorrow's rings.
options.case: Holds product clarity (one next decision is exactly the groggy-user rule); loses audience identification and a full yellow field is harsh at 6am in the dark.
options.risk: Saturated yellow in a dark bedroom is glare.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Tomorrow's rings as departure rows; a ring that's been solved flips to DEPARTED.
options.viewport: Home: rows of rings by time with status column; morning: the active row large.
options.case: Strong audience identification with times and status; loses clarity because flap animation and dense rows fight a groggy reader.
options.risk: Becomes a costume of the board if rows are set in flap cells.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.case: Overlaps the boarding-pass pick and loses on both axes against the station clock.
options.kept: Nothing disappears, it cancels: solved rings stay visible, struck through, in the day's record.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: No identification for a groggy sleeper; cream ground is wrong in the dark.
options.kept: Fixed scale on one shared baseline across stages.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Pixel display type hurts legibility for bleary eyes; no link to waking.
options.kept: One form repeated at every size.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.case: Coded colour strips are the opposite of plain-language morning screens.
options.kept: Vast unprinted black with one element owning the field.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What iOS alarm apps ship (Alarmy, Clock), executed impeccably: system list of alarms, big time labels, one tint.
canonCard.viewport: Large title 'Alarms', rows of big times with switches, a full-screen challenge sheet in the morning.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the dozens of alarm apps it sits beside.
